A long quest in the Shattered Isles, south of Liberty Bay: you help the rebel pirates of {wiki:Meriana|Meriana} (Sabrehaven) against the raiding pirates of {wiki:Nargor|Nargor}. Along the way you unlock Goroma, the Goroma volcano (lair of {creature:Morgaroth}), Ramoa, Talahu, Malada, Kharos (Ferumbras Citadel), the Laguna Islands and Nargor. At the end you receive a {item:Model Ship}, the {wiki:Pirate Outfits|Pirate Outfits} and the achievement **Matchmaker**.
